components.note: 亻 (person) — relates to 传's meaning 'to pass on, transmit,' something passed from person to person.

辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 达's meaning 'to reach, arrive, achieve.'

⺈ (a person, bent over) — the figure whose outward expression is being depicted.
巴 — traditionally linked to desire or emotion, so together the character points to a person's expression or complexion, extended to 色's meaning 'color, appearance.'
刂 (a knife, related to 刀) — cutting and arranging pieces in order ties to 列's meaning 'row, line, to arrange'
钅 (metal) — 镇 originally referred to a heavy metal weight used to press something down, later extending to 'garrison town.'

各 (gè) gives a sound close to gé, differing mainly in tone.
木 (wood) — buildings were traditionally framed with wood.
娄 (lóu) gives the sound — an exact match with 楼.

meanings: to greet sb by word or action

components.note: 扌 (hand) — 打 relates to hitting or performing an action with the hand.
丁 (dīng) gives the sound — 打 is pronounced dǎ, a connection that has shifted in tone.
扌 (hand) — suggests a gesture, a beckoning motion.
召 depicts a call or summons — a hand gesture calling someone over gave 招 its meaning 'to beckon, to recruit.'
口 (mouth) — 呼 describes an action of the mouth, such as calling out or breathing.
乎 (hū) gives the sound — an exact match with 呼.
木 (tree/wood) — many early villages were built among or from trees and wood
寸 (cùn) gives a sound close to 村's reading cūn, sharing a similar historical pronunciation
广 (shelter/building) — 庄 originally referred to farm buildings or a manor house.
壯 (zhuàng) gives a sound close to zhuāng, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.
扌 (hand) — 报 relates to taking action against someone.

寸 (a hand) — guiding the way.
巳 (a place) — the destination being pointed toward, giving 导 its meaning 'to lead, guide, direct.'
阝 (a mound/place) — reflects 阿's original meaning related to a hill or slope
可 (kě) gives a sound close to 阿's reading ā
宀 (roof) — 富 relates to a well-stocked household, prosperous under its own roof

析 (xī) gives the sound — an exact match with 晰.
丶 (a dot) — represents the burning flame atop a lamp.

攵 (a hand with a stick) — 教 relates to instructing or disciplining, the traditional action of teaching.
孝 (xiào) gives a hint of the sound — 教 is pronounced jiào, a connection that has shifted somewhat.
氵 (water/stream) — water naturally follows a fixed course, an image linked to the idea of 'law' or 'method.'

木 (wood) — 案 originally referred to a wooden table or desk
安 (ān) gives a sound close to 案's reading àn, differing only in tone
汉 is a simplified form of 漢, pairing the water radical 氵 with a component that named the river valley tied to the Han dynasty and Han Chinese identity.
土 (earth) — relates to 城's meaning 'city, wall,' since city walls were built of earth.
成 (chéng) gives the sound — 城 is also pronounced chéng, an exact match.
尤 (particularly/outstanding) — relates to 就's sense of approaching or arriving at a particular point
京 (jīng, capital) gives a sound close to 就's pronunciation jiù
纟 (thread) — 绪 originally meant the end of a thread, extending to 'clue, beginnings.'
者 (zhě) gives a sound distantly related to xù's reading, having drifted apart over time.
Roof — shows shelter, a place to stay.
A person resting inside, suggesting lodging for the night.
人 (person) — 舍 originally described the shape of a roof over a person, a dwelling.
舌 (shé) is an exact match for the sound of 舍.
广 (shelter) pictures a drying shed.
林-shaped strokes below picture hemp fibers hung to dry, giving 麻 its meaning 'hemp.'
Wine — related to alcohol.

meanings: to tell it as it is

components.note: 讠 (speech) — 话 relates to speaking and words.
舌 (tongue) — the organ used for speaking, reinforcing 话's meaning of 'speech' or 'words.'
讠 (speech radical) — shows 说 relates to talking or language
兑 (duì) is the phonetic component; historically 说 was also pronounced closer to 兑's sound before shifting to shuō
纟 (silk/thread) — 细 relates to something as fine and thin as silk thread
田 (tián) gives a loose sound connection to 细's reading xì
Plant — links to fungi and mold, once seen as plant-like.
Gives the sound qūn, related to jūn but drifted apart over time.
阝 (a mound or place) — 队 pictures people gathering together.
人 (person) — people gathering in one place gave 队 its meaning 'a team' or 'a line/queue.'
又 (hand), shown twice and joined together — two hands clasped in friendship gave 友 its meaning 'friend.'
义 (yì) gives a sound close to yí, differing only in tone.
口 (a vessel), shown four times — a set of cooking vessels.
犬 (a dog) — guarding the vessels, the source of 器's meaning 'vessel, tool, instrument.'
口 (mouth), stacked three times — many mouths talking about or judging something, the source of 品's meaning 'product, item; quality, rank.'
口 (mouth) — 味 relates to taste, sensed in the mouth.
未 (wèi) gives the sound — an exact match with 味.
木 (wood/tree) — 标 originally referred to the tip of a tree, later coming to mean 'mark, sign'
票 (piào) gives a sound close to 标's reading biāo
⺮ (bamboo) — early signature tallies and slips were made of bamboo.
佥 (qiān) is an exact match for the sound of 签.
宀 (roof) — represents a home.
各 (each, various) — a person arriving from elsewhere and welcomed under one's roof gave 客 its meaning 'guest, visitor.'
户 (door) — 房 relates to a room or house, a space behind a door
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 房 is pronounced fáng, a close match
口 (mouth) — 知 relates to speaking what one knows.
矢 (shǐ) gives a hint of the sound — 知 is pronounced zhī, a connection that has faded over time.
目 (eye) — 眼 refers directly to the eye itself.
艮 (gèn) gives a sound hint — 眼 is pronounced yǎn; the rhyme has drifted apart over the centuries.
儿 (a person) — shown carrying a torch overhead, the source of 光's meaning 'light, brightness.'
火 (fire) — the torch's flame, the thing giving off the light.
毛 (fur, hair) — 表 originally pictured a fur garment worn on the outside.
衣 (clothing) — an outer fur wrap gave 表 its meaning of 'outer' or 'surface,' and later, 'to express' (showing something on the surface).
木 (wood) — 格 originally meant a wooden branch or standard, extended to 'pattern, style, rule.'
各 (gè) gives a sound hint — 格 is pronounced gé, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.
十 — traditionally read as a great man standing tall.
一 (the two horizontal strokes) — heaven above and earth below, which the king bridges, giving 王 its meaning 'king, monarch.'
囗 (a boundary/enclosure) surrounding 玉 (jade, treasure) — a country pictured as protected, valuable territory.
A drawing of a person standing with arms and legs spread wide — used to represent the idea of something being 'big' or 'great.'
彳 (step/walk) — relates directly to 往's meaning 'to go toward, in the direction of.'
王 (wáng) gives a sound hint — 往 is pronounced wǎng, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.
巾 (cloth) — 常 originally referred to a long skirt or banner made of cloth, later coming to mean something 'usual' or 'ordinary.'
尚 (shàng) gives a hint of the sound — 常 is pronounced cháng, a connection that has drifted over time.
A drawing of a robe's collar and folded sides, seen from the front.
木 (tree) — traditionally read as a tree that has borne fruit.
立 (standing) — standing close by to watch it grow, evoking closeness and nurture, extended to 亲's meaning 'close, dear; parent, relative.'
灬 (fire) — 热 relates directly to heat
执 (zhí) gives a loose sound connection to 热's reading rè
攵 (a hand with an implement, action) — relates to 放's meaning 'to let go, release, put.'
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 放 is pronounced fàng, a close match sharing the same rhyme.
A drawing of a person standing with arms and legs spread wide — used to represent the idea of something being 'big' or 'great.'
日 (sun) — 星 relates to bright heavenly bodies like the sun and stars
生 (shēng) gives a sound close to 星's reading xīng
阝 (a mound/place) — relates to 际's meaning 'border, between,' an edge or boundary marker.
示 (shì) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from jì.
屮 (a young sprout) growing up and out of 凵 (a container or pit) — a picture of something emerging, hence 'going out.'
氐 (dī) gives the sound — 低 is also pronounced dī, an exact match
讠 (speech) — relates to 调's meaning 'to adjust, transfer,' something coordinated through spoken negotiation.
周 (zhōu) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from diào.
耳 (ear) — the original meaning of 耶 is unrelated to its modern use, which is mainly phonetic.
阝 (a place-name element) gives a sound distantly related to yé, having drifted apart over time.
鱼 (fish) forms the top of the character.
日, placed beneath the fish, was linked to the idea of speaking crudely or bluntly, giving 鲁 its meaning 'rash, uncouth.'
木 (tree) — 棕 names the palm tree, and the brown color associated with its fiber.
宗 (zōng) gives the sound — an exact match with 棕.
木 (tree) — 榈 names a type of tree, the palm.
闾 (lǘ) gives the sound — an exact match with 榈's reading.
阝 (a mound/settlement) — represents a city or town.
余 (surplus, remainder) — the leftover waste a city produces, which must be cleared away, giving 除 its meaning 'to remove, eliminate.'
匕 here relates to a person crouching or sitting — 此 originally pictured 'this place' where someone is.
止 (zhǐ) gives a hint of the sound — 此 is pronounced cǐ, sharing a similar final though the initial has shifted over time.
A stylized foot (related to 止, 'to stop/foot') — originally meant 'to go,' later grammaticalized into a literary possessive/linking particle, similar to 的.
夕 (evening, night) — divination was traditionally done in the evening.

㐱 (zhěn) gives the sound — an exact match with 诊.
宀 (roof) — 室 refers to an enclosed room under a roof
至 (zhì) gives the sound — an exact match with 室's reading shì

寺 (sì) gives a hint of the sound — 特 is pronounced tè, a connection that has drifted over time.
女 (woman) — 婚 relates to marriage, historically centered on the wife.
昏 (hūn) gives the sound — an exact match with 婚.
纟 (thread) — 纱 names a type of light, thin fabric, gauze.

旦 (dàn) gives a sound close to tǎn, sharing a related rhyme.

走 (to walk/run) — 趣 originally related to hurrying eagerly toward something, extending to 'interesting, of interest.'
取 (qǔ) gives a sound close to qù, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.

木 (tree) — 相 pictures looking closely at a tree.

讠 (speech) — 诞 originally described boastful, exaggerated speech.
延 (yán) gives a sound distantly related to dàn, having drifted apart over time.
屮 (a young shoot) growing up out of 土 (earth/soil) — a picture of new life emerging from the ground.
匕 (a kneeling person) — a mourner bowed down in grief.
歹 (skeletal remains) — the corpse being mourned, the source of 死's meaning 'to die, dead.'
礻 (an altar, related to ritual/spirits) — 神 relates to gods and spirits.
申 (shēn) gives a hint of the sound — 神 is pronounced shén, a connection that has shifted over time.
金 depicts a bell or metal casting mold, with dots representing droplets of molten metal — a picture linked to metal and, later, specifically gold.
⺈ (a person, bent over) — the figure whose outward expression is being depicted.
巴 — traditionally linked to desire or emotion, so together the character points to a person's expression or complexion, extended to 色's meaning 'color, appearance.'
辶 (to walk/move) — 适 relates to fitting well as one moves along, i.e. being suitable
舌 (shé) gives a sound distantly related to 适's reading shì, having drifted apart over a long time
心 (heart/mind) — 忠 describes a heart that stays true, loyalty.
中 (zhōng) is an exact match for the sound of 忠.

meanings: to enjoy (i.e. have the use or benefit of)

components.note: 亠 (a roof) — the top of a house.
口 (a mouth) — eating and enjoying inside it.
子 (a child) — together showing a family living and eating well under one roof, giving 享 its meaning 'to enjoy.'

meanings: to indicate clearly and with certainty

components.note: 扌 (hand) — 指 relates to using the hand, specifically the fingers.
旨 (an aim, purpose) — combined with 扌 (hand), 指 came to mean 'finger' and 'to point,' aiming the hand at something.
宀 (roof) — represents a home or fixed dwelling.
疋 (a foot/person) — a person settling down under a roof gave 定 its meaning 'to decide, to fix, to settle.'
